metadata.title: Holomorphic Sectional Curvature of Flag Manifolds via Kähler Reduction
metadata.abstract: We give an alternative proof of Li and Petersen's theorem that every invariant Kähler metric on a compact generalized flag manifold has positive holomorphic sectional curvature. For a unitary partial flag manifold, we realize the given metric by Kähler reduction of a Hermitian vector space. The defining equations place the level set on a sphere of radius \varrho, where the radial component of its second fundamental form gives the explicit lower bound 4/\varrho2 through the quotient curvature formula. Finally, we use a holomorphic isometric totally geodesic embedding to transfer the bound to generalized flag manifolds of every Lie type.
